_readme: Plug anything into Jarvis. Set enabled to true, put secrets in backend/.env and reference them as ${NAME}. Then say 'Jarvis, reload integrations' or use Settings > Integrations > Reload. Guide: README.md, section Integrations.

browser._about: Playwright: lets Jarvis drive web pages by their structure instead of pixels (fill forms, click links, read pages). Uses your installed Chrome.

files._about: Official filesystem server, limited to the folders you list.

github._about: GitHub's hosted MCP server: issues, PRs, repos, actions. Needs GITHUB_TOKEN (a personal access token) in backend/.env.

home_assistant._about: Home Assistant's built-in MCP server (Settings > Devices > Add integration > Model Context Protocol Server). Needs HA_TOKEN.

http_actions.name: phone_notify
http_actions.description: Send a push notification to the user's phone (via the free ntfy app). Use for 'ping my phone', 'remind me on my phone'.

http_actions.name: n8n_workflow
http_actions.description: Trigger the user's n8n automation workflow with a payload.

http_actions.name: lights
http_actions.description: Turn a Home Assistant light on or off.
